name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
summary: A Minor Manifestation of Earth is a localized elemental spirit bound to sacred stones in Mulgore and Durotar. Invisible to ordinary sight, it reveals itself only to fledgling shamans who drink the sacred Earth Sapta, providing the rough quartz required to carve their very first earth totem.

sections.title: Voice of the Stone
sections.body: The spirits of the earth dwell everywhere beneath the dirt and stone, but communicating with them requires deliberate ritual. At sacred landmarks like Kodo Rock in Mulgore and Spirit Rock in Durotar, Minor Manifestations of Earth linger in the unseen realm, surrounded by even smaller elemental presences. Only initiates who have drunk the Earth Sapta—a ritual draught brewed by shamanic mentors—can lift the veil between the physical world and the elements. Once acknowledged, the spirit imparts the earth's blessings along with a piece of rough quartz, granting the novice the spiritual focal point needed to fashion an Earth Totem.

faq.q: Why can't I see the Minor Manifestation of Earth?
faq.answer: The manifestation exists on the elemental plane and remains invisible to the naked eye. You must drink an Earth Sapta, provided by your shaman trainer, to enter the altered state of perception required to perceive and speak with elemental spirits.

faq.q: Where can these earth spirits be found?
aliases: where to find manifestation of earth
faq.answer: They appear at Kodo Rock in the rolling plains of Mulgore and at Spirit Rock in the arid canyons of Durotar. Both sites serve as traditional proving grounds for young tauren, orc, and troll shamans.

faq.q: What is the spirit's purpose during the rite?
faq.answer: The manifestation tests and formally acknowledges the initiate's connection to the earth element. Upon speaking with the shaman, it bestows a piece of rough quartz, which is taken back to a shaman trainer to construct the Earth Totem.

faq.q: What are the smaller creatures surrounding it?
faq.answer: Surrounding the central spirit are lesser manifestations of earth. They are minor echos of the element drawn to the sacred grounds, existing purely as part of the natural communion, and cannot be directly interacted with.

angles.text: Every young Horde shaman must commune with a Minor Manifestation of Earth under the influence of the Earth Sapta to earn their very first totem.
Tauren youth travel east across Mulgore to Kodo Rock to seek communion with this manifestation as part of their ancestral spiritual trials.
